binary_sensor.name: 客厅双雷达有人
binary_sensor.state: {% set p = states('sensor.ld2410_usb_json') | from_json({}) %}{% set src = states.sensor.ld2410_usb_json %}{% set age = as_timestamp(now()) - as_timestamp(src.last_reported, 0) %}{% set valid = p is mapping and p.get('occupancy') is boolean and 0 <= age <= 20 %}{{ is_state('binary_sensor.linp_cn_1130732284_hb01_occupancy_status_p_2_1', 'on') or (valid and p.occupancy) }}
binary_sensor.availability: {% set p = states('sensor.ld2410_usb_json') | from_json({}) %}{% set src = states.sensor.ld2410_usb_json %}{% set age = as_timestamp(now()) - as_timestamp(src.last_reported, 0) %}{% set valid = p is mapping and p.get('occupancy') is boolean and 0 <= age <= 20 %}{{ is_state('binary_sensor.linp_cn_1130732284_hb01_occupancy_status_p_2_1', 'on') or (valid and p.occupancy) or (is_state('binary_sensor.linp_cn_1130732284_hb01_occupancy_status_p_2_1', 'off') and valid and not p.occupancy) }}

attributes.usb_data_valid: {% set p = states('sensor.ld2410_usb_json') | from_json({}) %}{% set src = states.sensor.ld2410_usb_json %}{% set age = as_timestamp(now()) - as_timestamp(src.last_reported, 0) %}{% set valid = p is mapping and p.get('occupancy') is boolean and 0 <= age <= 20 %}{{ valid }}
attributes.usb_occupancy: {% set p = states('sensor.ld2410_usb_json') | from_json({}) %}{% set src = states.sensor.ld2410_usb_json %}{% set age = as_timestamp(now()) - as_timestamp(src.last_reported, 0) %}{% set valid = p is mapping and p.get('occupancy') is boolean and 0 <= age <= 20 %}{{ p.occupancy if valid else 'invalid' }}
attributes.policy: 任一有效有人即有人；两路有效无人即无人；串口20秒未上报视为无效
